brand_voice_note: Warm, proudly queer and maker-made, mixing playful nerdy energy with plainspoken activism and real-body practicality.

concepts.product_title: Proud to the Bone Glow-in-the-Dark Human Skull Progress Pride Enamel Pin
concepts.primary_text:
Proud in daylight. Glowing after dark. 💀

Our Proud to the Bone skull pin fills with glow-in-the-dark pigment, so the progress-pride flowers light up pale green the second the lights go down.

Big, beautiful, durable and bright - a NerdyKeppie exclusive from our Portland studio, made by and for our community.
concepts.headline: Pride That Glows in the Dark
concepts.why_it_works: The glow feature is this pin's single most delightful, share-worthy outcome, so leading with that sensory payoff is stronger than quality or story for a collectible.
concepts.visual_direction: The single glow skull pin resting face-up on a folded linen napkin on a dim nightstand, a faint green glow lifting off the enamel beside a small brass lamp.

concepts.product_title: Galaxy Rainbow Gay Pride Zipper Pouch with T-Bottom
concepts.primary_text:
Where's my HRT kit? Where are my dice? Where's my makeup?

Meet the Galaxy pouch. Wide T-bottom so it stands up on its own, plenty of internal space, and a rainbow nebula print you can spot in the bottom of any bag.

HRT and injection kit, dice bag, travel makeup, or whatever you need to keep close - fully lined, one zip, done.
concepts.headline: One Pouch, Everything Stashed
concepts.why_it_works: The description literally lists the daily 'where did I put it' friction (HRT, dice, makeup), so naming that problem and solving it with the wide standing pouch lands directly with this audience.
concepts.visual_direction: The galaxy pouch standing upright on a light wood dresser beside an open travel bag, loose dice and a lip balm alongside for scale.

concepts.product_title: "TACOS NOT TERFS" - Fish Outta Water Films Original Cotton Tee Shirt
concepts.primary_text:
TACOS NOT TERFS. We mean it.

This tee is by Fish Outta Water Films, a UK-based queer and disabled videography duo, made in response to the rising anti-trans climate they live in. Funds from every shirt go directly toward the crew's transition costs.

Printed in-house at our 100% queer-run, family-owned Portland studio. Soft, comfy, and the perfect shirt to march in a Pride parade in.
concepts.headline: Wear It. Fund Real Transitions.
concepts.why_it_works: This shirt's whole reason to exist is the guest artists and where the money goes, so the founder/why-we-made-this story is the honest, activist lever that fits it best.
concepts.visual_direction: The maroon TACOS NOT TERFS tee laid flat and squared on a worn wooden print-studio worktable, ink jars and a folded canvas apron nearby.
